description: This file defines the MessageFormatter class in the GuzzleHttp namespace, responsible for formatting HTTP request and response messages into log strings using variable substitution templates.

classes.name: MessageFormatter
classes.description: A class that formats HTTP messages into log strings based on templates, supporting various placeholders for request and response data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MessageFormatter with a specified template or defaults to CLF.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Generates a formatted log message string from a request, optional response, and optional error.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Helper method to extract headers from a message as a string.
